chunking.ordering: strict contiguous; duplicates and gaps denied

base64url.unit: each independently encoded contiguous UTF8 byte slice

fields.seq: strictly increasing nonnegative int64 per connection
fields.entries: complete namespace map; initial is static, load/save is persisted furniture
fields.ground_sig: empty for initial; complete compact durable ground order for load/save

entry.send_id: nonnegative int32 used by this component's outgoing C2S packet
entry.receive_id: nonnegative int32 consumed by this client's incoming receiver
entry.anchor: static exact unique top-root name after stripping only trailing (Clone); empty for furniture
entry.path: nonnegative int32[] relative to and excluding the static anchor or placed ground root
entry.slot: zero-based index in the full GameObject m_Component array
entry.ground_index: -1 for static; compact persisted ground-array index for furniture
entry.item_id: empty for static; exact canonical housing item ID for furniture
entry.dual_id_reason: RemoveOccupable removes a dense-list element without renumbering the component counter ID. Occupable send_id and receive_id can diverge after delete/save/readd. Generic IDs must remain equal.

c2s.ground_signature: Array in compact persisted load order. Transform numbers are IEEE754 float32 round-trip JSON numbers; negative zero normalizes to positive zero. Server compares typed float32 bits, not raw JSON or a client digest.

s2c_optional_ack.client_dependency: none in v1; server owns queue/snapshot release and native v1 need not parse this ack

trust_snapshot.instances: Exact housing binding plus reviewed static scene manifest, typed durable ground signature, and expanded reviewed furniture component entries.
trust_snapshot.unresolved_policy: Any layout item whose prefab manifest is unresolved denies the whole instance registry.

lifecycle.initial: Complete static map. Deferred minigame and separate-protocol members must be present for ID completeness but are denied for 94 relay.
lifecycle.load: Complete durable furniture map and exact authoritative ground signature, for owners and visitors.
lifecycle.save: Candidate map freezes furniture interaction immediately. It remains pending for at most 10 seconds until backend-published typed ground signature matches.
lifecycle.epoch_change: Generic and occupancy state is cleared. Pending owner can commit against new authority. Stale mapped visitors are disconnected to force normal HTTP layout reload and a fresh registry.
lifecycle.queue: A bridge-required profile opts the authenticated peer in before its first 97. At most 64 pre-ready opcode 8/94 packets are queued; stale numeric IDs are discarded when a complete trusted map commits. 9/10 fail closed until ready. Queue flush and semantic snapshots happen only after both namespaces are ready.
lifecycle.compatibility: Legacy profiles retain earlier raw behavior. The nonmini-semantic-v1 profile requires the bridge in process metadata and never permits raw fallback even if the client hook fails to load.

translation.8: Resolve sender send_id to semantic occupable key; reply 10##recipient receive_id when free or 9#requester#recipient receive_id#occupant when held.
translation.9: Resolve sender send_id and claim atomically. Success delivers recipient receive_id to every ready peer including sender. Any rejected opcode9 from an authenticated opted-in peer disconnects it to reload, because native seats animate before every possible server rejection and expose no proven rollback packet; conflicts retain typed registry_occupable_claim_conflict evidence.
translation.10: Verify semantic occupant and deliver recipient receive_id to every ready opt-in peer including sender.
translation.94: Validate semantic ordinary policy and extension arity, retain by semantic key, and deliver recipient receive_id to every ready opt-in peer including sender.

readiness_boundary: The explicit nonmini-semantic-v1 validation scope admits only a fresh complete trusted descriptor; mixed scenes include all deferred keys but deny them at relay. This does not set game_ready, protocol_complete, or networking parity true.
